source_status: derived parametric collision/guide mechanism; not claimed native functionality of any imported mesh

thread_guide.model: actuated D6 helical guide approximation, not threaded mesh contact
thread_guide.axial_target: closed_z + pitch * accumulated_MEASURED_relative_rotation / (2*pi), clipped to engagement range

receiver.asset: imported sample-data petri_dish lower CAD body; matched derived convex collision dimensions

boundary: No RM65-B controller or grasp involved
Bottle is driven by a declared kinematic test fixture
Cap is dynamic, guided by a force/torque limited constraint until release
After release a separate declared test gripper holds/removes the cap
Tablets are initialized once, then moved only by physics
No liquid simulation or chemical/material calibration
No real helical thread friction, cross-threading or human push-and-turn safety cap
